<article class="markdown-body entry-content container-lg" itemprop="text">
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">
<h1 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Ruff! documentation generator</h1>
<a id="user-content-ruff-documentation-generator" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Ruff! documentation generator" href="#ruff-documentation-generator">
<svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true">
<path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path>
</svg>
</a>
</div>
<p dir="auto">Ruff! (Runtime function formatter) is a documentation generation system
for programs written in the Tcl programming language. Ruff! uses runtime
introspection in conjunction with comment analysis to generate reference
documentation for Tcl programs with minimal effort on the programmer's part.</p>
<p dir="auto">
See 
<a href="https://ruff.magicsplat.com" rel="nofollow">https://ruff.magicsplat.com</a>
 for features and reference documentation. Source
repository lives at 
<a href="https://github.com/apnadkarni/ruff">https://github.com/apnadkarni/ruff</a>
.
</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto">
<h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Why Ruff!</h2>
<a id="user-content-why-ruff" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Why Ruff!" href="#why-ruff">
<svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true">
<path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path>
</svg>
</a>
</div>
<p dir="auto">Ruff! produces documentation that not only requires less duplication
of effort from the programmer, but is also more complete, more
accurate and more maintainable.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto">Comments in source code do not have to be reproduced for documentation
purposes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Ruff! requires minimal markup in the comments making it lightweight
as well as reducing clutter.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Supports inline formatting using Markdown syntax.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Embedded diagrams in multiple formats</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Program elements like command arguments, defaults and
class relationships like inheritance are automatically derived.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Maintenance is less of a burden as documentation is automatically
updated with source modification such as changes to defaults, addition of
mix-ins etc.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">On the output side,</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto">Ruff! supports multiple formats (HTML, Markdown, reStructuredText, Asciidoc
and nroff).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Generated documentation can optionally be split across multiple pages.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Hyperlinks between program elements, and optionally source code,
make navigation easy and efficient.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">A table of contents and optional searchable index permits quick
location of command and class documentation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">Class relationships are extracted and the full API for a class, with inherited
and mixed-in methods and properties, is flattened and summarized.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto">HTML output supports navigation and user-selectable themes.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p dir="auto">For additional examples of Ruff! generated documentation, see</p>
<p dir="auto">
<a href="https://iocp.magicsplat.com" rel="nofollow">iocp</a>
,

<a href="https://cffi.magicsplat.com" rel="nofollow">cffi</a>
,

<a href="http://www.cawt.tcl3d.org/download/CawtReference.html" rel="nofollow">CAWT</a>
,

<a href="https://www.tcl3d.org/mawt/download/MawtReference.html" rel="nofollow">MAWT</a>
,

<a href="https://www.tcl3d.org/pawt/download/PawtReference.html" rel="nofollow">PAWT</a>
,

<a href="https://georgtree.github.io/SpiceGenTcl/" rel="nofollow">SpiceGenTcl</a>
,

<a href="https://aplsimple.github.io/en/tcl/pave/apave.html" rel="nofollow">apave</a>
,

<a href="https://aplsimple.github.io/en/tcl/baltip/baltip.html" rel="nofollow">baltip</a>
,

<a href="https://aplsimple.github.io/en/tcl/hl_tcl/hl_tcl.html" rel="nofollow">hl-tcl</a>
,

<a href="https://tcl-promise.magicsplat.com" rel="nofollow">tcl-promise</a>
,

<a href="https://nico-robert.github.io/tomato/" rel="nofollow">tomato</a>
,

<a href="https://tcl-obex.magicsplat.com" rel="nofollow">obex</a>
,

<a href="http://woof.sourceforge.net/woof-ug-0.5/html/_woof/woof_manual.html" rel="nofollow">Woof!</a>

and

<a href="https://tcl-vix.magicsplat.com/" rel="nofollow">tcl-vix</a>
.

<p dir="auto">Note this is a major release and there may be subtle incompatibilities with
2.x releases in both parsing of input and generated output.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
New output formats reStructuredText (Sphinx) and Asciidoc
</li>
<li>
New command 
<code>coverage</code>
 to list undocumented or partially documented components
</li>
<li>
New command line interface 
<em>2.x incompatibility</em>
</li>
<li>
Support for numbered lists
</li>
<li>
Support for block quotes
</li>
<li>
Support for tables
</li>
<li>
Support for HTML entities
</li>
<li>
Include OO class methods in documentation
</li>
<li>
Provision for class preambles, oo::configurable property descriptions and
Tk-like option documentation via 
<code>_ruffClassHook_</code>
 (Tcl 9 only)
</li>
<li>
Customizable namespace headings
</li>
<li>
Customizable per-namespace options
</li>
<li>
New 
<code>-onlyexports</code>
 / 
<code>--only-exports</code>
 option to only document exported commands
</li>
<li>
Order in which class and command sections are displayed is now based
on the 
<code>-include</code>
 / 
<code>--include</code>
 option
</li>
<li>
Program elements in navigation pane now use a monospace font.
</li>
<li>
Tcl core built-ins are ignored when documenting global namespace (bug fix)
</li>
<li>
The 
<code>document</code>
 command no longer supports supports the 
<code>-preeval</code>
 option. Do any
required evaluation in the caller before invoking 
<code>document</code>
.

<em>2.x incompatibility</em>
</li>
</ul>

<ul dir="auto">
<li>
Added Nroff formatter for Unix manpages.
</li>
<li>
Added themes with end-user selection.
</li>
<li>

</li>
<li>

</li>
<li>
Proc and method synopsis overrides, for example

</li>

) instead

</li>

<code>-stylesheets</code>

</li>

<code>-navigation</code>
 option only takes 
<code>scrolled</code>
<code>sticky</code>
 as valid values.
</li>
<li>
<strong>Incompatibility:</strong>
 The 
<code>-output</code>
 option is not supported. Use

<code>-outfile</code>
 and 
<code>-outdir</code>
 instead.
</li>
<li>
<strong>Incompatibility:</strong>
 Output file names use hyphen as a separator
instead of underscore.
</li>
<li>
<a href="https://github.com/apnadkarni/ruff/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3Av2.0+label%3Abug">Bug fixes</a>
</li>
</ul>
